name: Lovely Monsters
source:
Ancient stolen dagger, a creature escaped from the cage, and all kinds of night dwellers suddenly interested in a mortal who got in all of this mess by mistake. Nights are beautiful in the city of Kyiv, but can you survive at least this one?

[From [url=https://martesa.itch.io/lovely-monsters]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
古代被盗的匕首，从笼子里逃出来的生物，各种夜栖者突然对一个误入这一切混乱的凡人产生了兴趣。基辅市的夜晚很美，但你至少能活过这一夜吗？

[来自[url=https://martesa.itch.io/lovely-monsters]Itch.io[/url]]
